data.content: What is the temporal coverage (min/max year) of the monitoring data stored on MEASURED_AT relationships?

args.query: What is the minimum and maximum year of monitoring data stored on MEASURED_AT relationships?

data.content:
The results comprise 1 rows:
            
            <data>
            {"MinYear":{"0":1998},"MaxYear":{"0":2020}}
            </data>
            
            Provide the user with a Markdown formatted table of the data and a textual summary.
            <summary>
            {"MinYear":{"count":1.0,"mean":1998.0,"std":null,"min":1998.0,"25%":1998.0,"50%":1998.0,"75%":1998.0,"max":1998.0},"MaxYear":{"count":1.0,"mean":2020.0,"std":null,"min":2020.0,"25%":2020.0,"50%":2020.0,"75%":2020.0,"max":2020.0}}
            </summary>
            
            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH ()-[r:MEASURED_AT]->()
RETURN min(r.year) AS MinYear, max(r.year) AS MaxYear

            ```
            
            Always provide the Zenodo link `https://zenodo.org/records/14616124` of the docker container holding
            the full Neo4j graph database where the user can access the complete result with the cypher query.
data.name: CypherSearch

data.content:
The temporal coverage of the monitoring data stored on MEASURED_AT relationships is as follows:

| MinYear | MaxYear |
|---------|---------|
| 1998    | 2020    |

- The earliest year with monitoring data is 1998.
- The latest year with monitoring data is 2020.

Cypher query used:
```cypher
MATCH ()-[r:MEASURED_AT]->()
RETURN min(r.year) AS MinYear, max(r.year) AS MaxYear
```

For full access to the Neo4j graph database and further exploration, you can use the Zenodo resource: https://zenodo.org/records/14616124
